title: The Braid Longer Than Pavel's Arms
youtube_title: The Braid Longer Than Pavel's Arms | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A gift too big for one basket is just right when it is shared.
summary: Pavel's honey braid will not fit one basket, so he, Emile, and Nkechi rest it, loosen it into three pieces, and send the bread to more than one table.
